newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks trail Dow higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks trail Dow higher at open.

text.p: The Australian share market trailed the rebounding Dow higher at the open on Thursday with the mining leaders receiving extra assistance from firmer base metals prices.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index added 7.0 points to 2,330.7.
Brokers said the market looked set for another day of modest gains with turnover to be boosted by options-related trade as the December series options expired.
"It's following the Dow with options (trade) helping the volumes," said a Sydney broker.
"Metals are helping the miners but the banks are going nowhere with the bonds a bit softer."
Expectations were for a single figure finish in relatively quiet activity.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about five to two, while about 44 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
